name.zh: SeaBreeze Inspector 海上风机巡检无人机—机械臂系统
name.en: SeaBreeze Inspector Offshore Wind UAV-Arm System

description.zh: 面向海上风力机叶片巡检的低成本无人机—机械臂系统：Tello 飞行平台、3-DOF SG90 机械臂、EKF 扰动观测抗风悬停、RRT* 巡检路径规划、YOLO 叶片缺陷检测、地面站与 3D 数字孪生、OmniSim 风场桥接。
description.en: Low-cost UAV-arm system for offshore wind-turbine blade inspection: Tello platform, 3-DOF SG90 arm, EKF disturbance-observer wind-robust hover, RRT* inspection planning, YOLO blade-defect detection, ground station and 3D digital twin, OmniSim wind-bridge integration.

description.zh: 仓库内的数据与训练产物位置（多为 gitignore 的大体积资产，此处只记录布局与来源，不描述算法）：data/weights 下的 YOLO 权重（seabreeze_v3.pt、best.onnx/torchscript）、datasets/derived/v5_2_adjudicated 已裁决数据集、runs/ 下的训练与验证输出、data/processed/logs 下的飞行 CSV。
description.en: Where in-repo data and training artefacts live (mostly gitignored large assets; this records layout and provenance only, not algorithm): YOLO weights under data/weights (seabreeze_v3.pt, best.onnx/torchscript), the adjudicated dataset under datasets/derived/v5_2_adjudicated, training and validation outputs under runs/, and flight CSVs under data/processed/logs.

description.zh: 数据侧的可提交产物：划分清单 split_manifest.csv 与缺陷类别定义 wind_turbine_defect.yaml。
description.en: Committable data-side artefacts: the split manifest and the defect class definition.

description.zh: 数据集划分清单。
description.en: Dataset split manifest.

description.zh: 缺陷类别定义。
description.en: Defect class definition.

description.zh: 检测权重的位置约定（data/weights 与训练输出 runs/train/**/weights），仓库内仅保留占位文件。
description.en: Where detection weights live (data/weights and runs/train/**/weights); only placeholder files are kept in the repository.

description.zh: 检测权重占位。
description.en: Detection-weight placeholder.

description.zh: 训练权重输出目录。
description.en: Training-weight output directory.

description.zh: Python 后端：算法核心（EKF/前馈 PID/RRT*/滤波）、Tello 飞控接口、机械臂运动学、YOLO 缺陷检测、Pygame 仿真与 HTTP 桥、单循环 runtime、任务状态机与失效保护、硬件抽象层、发布订阅总线与配置。
description.en: Python backend: algorithm core (EKF / feedforward PID / RRT* / filters), Tello flight interface, arm kinematics, YOLO defect detection, Pygame simulation and HTTP bridge, single control-loop runtime, mission FSM and failsafe, HAL, pub-sub bus and configuration.

description.zh: 3DOF 机械臂：底座/大臂/小臂的正逆运动学（数值 IK + 多初始猜测 + 雅可比）与串口控制器（Arduino Nano，A<base>,<shoulder>,<elbow> 指令，角度可查询与归位）。连杆长度与串口参数由 arm_config.yaml 提供。
description.en: 3-DOF arm: forward/inverse kinematics for base, shoulder and elbow (numerical IK with multi-start guesses plus a Jacobian) and a serial controller for the Arduino Nano (A<base>,<shoulder>,<elbow> commands, angle query and homing). Link lengths and serial parameters come from arm_config.yaml.

description.zh: 经 pyserial 与 Arduino Nano 通信的机械臂控制器：默认串口与波特率取自 arm_config.yaml 的 hardware.serial；set_joint_angles 发送 A<base>,<shoulder>,<elbow> 指令，并按固件 50°/s 的平滑速度估算等待时间；move_to_position 先 IK 再下发角度；get_current_angles 发 Q 并解析 A:90,S:45,E:30；reset 归位到 (90,90,90)。pyserial 缺失或未连接时降级为模拟模式。
description.en: Arm controller talking to an Arduino Nano over pyserial: the port and baud rate default to hardware.serial in arm_config.yaml; set_joint_angles sends A<base>,<shoulder>,<elbow> and waits based on the firmware's fixed 50 deg/s smoothing; move_to_position solves IK before commanding angles; get_current_angles sends Q and parses A:90,S:45,E:30; reset homes to (90,90,90). Missing pyserial or an unopened port degrades to simulated mode.

description.zh: 打开串口并等待 2s 让 Arduino 复位；缺库或异常时打印原因并返回 False。
description.en: Opens the serial port and waits 2 s for the Arduino to reset; missing library or errors are logged and return False.

description.zh: 发送三关节角度指令，并按最大角度差 × 20ms/度 估算等待时间后更新当前角度缓存。
description.en: Sends the three joint angles, waiting max-angle-delta x 20 ms/deg before updating the cached current angles.

description.zh: 先 IK 求解 (x,y,z) 得到关节角，再调用 set_joint_angles 下发。
description.en: Solves IK for (x,y,z) and then dispatches the resulting angles via set_joint_angles.

description.zh: 发送 Q 查询并解析 A:90,S:45,E:30 回复，失败时返回缓存的当前角度。
description.en: Sends Q and parses the A:90,S:45,E:30 reply, returning the cached angles on failure.
Homes the arm to (90,90,90).

description.zh: 底座/大臂/小臂三关节运动学：FK 由 θ1..θ3 求末端 (x,y,z)，其中小臂与末端共线（L23=L2+L3）；IK 用 L-BFGS-B 数值优化加 5×5×4 初始猜测网格搜索，保证与 FK 一致，无 scipy 时退化为解析解并处理 r≈0 与超出工作空间两种退化情形；Jacobian 给出 3×3 雅可比供速度控制。连杆长度优先从 arm_config.yaml 读取。
description.en: Kinematics for the base/shoulder/elbow joints: FK maps theta1..theta3 to the end-effector (x,y,z) with the forearm and tip collinear (L23=L2+L3); IK runs L-BFGS-B over a 5x5x4 multi-start grid to stay consistent with FK, degrading to an analytic solution without scipy while handling the r~0 and out-of-workspace degeneracies; Jacobian returns the 3x3 Jacobian for velocity control. Link lengths are read from arm_config.yaml first.

description.zh: 正运动学：三关节角度（度）→ 末端位置 (x,y,z) mm。
description.en: Forward kinematics: joint angles in degrees to end-effector (x,y,z) in mm.

description.zh: 逆运动学：末端 (x,y,z) mm → [θ1,θ2,θ3] 度，数值优化 + 多初始猜测，失败回退解析解与默认姿态。
description.en: Inverse kinematics: end-effector (x,y,z) in mm to [theta1,theta2,theta3] in degrees via numerical optimisation with multi-start guesses, falling back to the analytic solution and a default pose.

description.zh: 计算 3×3 雅可比矩阵，用于关节速度到末端速度的映射。
description.en: Computes the 3x3 Jacobian mapping joint rates to end-effector velocity.

description.zh: 角度转弧度的薄封装。
description.en: Thin degrees-to-radians helper.

description.zh: 弧度转角度的薄封装，IK 解析分支使用。
description.en: Thin radians-to-degrees helper used by the analytic IK branch.

description.zh: 飞行控制与规划算法核心：12 维 EKF 扰动观测器（自适应 Q）、前馈+PID 位置控制器、PT1 低通与积分分离数字滤波器、RRT* 三维避障路径规划。全部为纯 NumPy/SciPy 实现，需在 10Hz 控制周期内完成单次递推。
description.en: Flight-control and planning algorithm core: a 12-state EKF disturbance observer with adaptive Q, a feedforward+PID position controller, PT1 low-pass and integral-separation filters, and RRT* 3D obstacle-avoiding path planning. Pure NumPy/SciPy, sized for one recursion per 10 Hz control cycle.

description.zh: 12 维全状态扩展卡尔曼扰动观测器。状态 X=[x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,ax,ay,az,dx,dy,dz]，观测 Z=[IMU 加速度×3, 光流位置×2, 气压高度]。常加速度模型 + 扰动随机游走，观测线性无需雅可比；predict(u) 把已知控制加速度灌入状态，从而把 IMU 残差归因于风扰；残差 Mahalanobis 距离超阈值时按 α 放大 Q，加快阵风跟踪。
description.en: 12-state EKF disturbance observer. State X=[x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,ax,ay,az,dx,dy,dz], measurement Z=[IMU accel x3, optical-flow position x2, barometric height]. Constant-acceleration model plus disturbance random walk; the measurement model is linear so no Jacobian is needed. predict(u) injects the known control acceleration so the IMU residual is attributed to wind, and an over-threshold Mahalanobis residual inflates Q by alpha to track gusts faster.

description.zh: 12 状态常加速度模型的 F 矩阵与 6 维线性观测的 H 矩阵构建（观测线性、无需雅可比）。
description.en: Builds the F matrix of the 12-state constant-acceleration model and the H matrix of the linear 6-D measurement (no Jacobian needed).

description.zh: 构建 F 矩阵。
description.en: Builds the F matrix.

description.zh: 构建 H 矩阵。
description.en: Builds the H matrix.

description.zh: 预测步（灌入已知控制加速度，使 IMU 残差可归因于风扰）与更新步（Joseph 形式协方差），以及自适应 Q 调整。
description.en: The predict step (injecting known control acceleration so the IMU residual is attributed to wind) and the update step (Joseph-form covariance), plus adaptive Q adjustment.

description.zh: 预测步。
description.en: Predict step.

description.zh: 更新步。
description.en: Update step.

description.zh: 自适应过程噪声。
description.en: Adaptive process noise.

description.zh: 对外读出接口：状态/扰动/位置/速度/协方差与残差马氏距离，以及状态与协方差复位。
description.en: Read-out interface: state, disturbance, position, velocity, covariance and residual Mahalanobis distance, plus state/covariance reset.

description.zh: 读完整状态。
description.en: Reads the full state.

description.zh: 读扰动等效加速度。
description.en: Reads disturbance acceleration.

description.zh: 读协方差 P。
description.en: Reads covariance P.

description.zh: 残差马氏距离。
description.en: Residual Mahalanobis distance.

description.zh: 复位状态与协方差。
description.en: Resets state and covariance.

name.zh: 前馈 PID 位置控制器

description.zh: 位置环控制律 v_cmd = Kp·e + Ki·∫e + Kd·ė + Kff·d_est。含死区、积分限幅与饱和暂停（anti-windup）、D 项 PT1 低通、积分分离；输出按 max_speed 限幅且保持方向，并回传各项分解供诊断。from_config() 从 drone_config.yaml 的 controller/flight 段读取增益、控制频率与最大速度。
description.en: Position-loop law v_cmd = Kp*e + Ki*int(e) + Kd*e_dot + Kff*d_est. Includes a dead zone, integral clamping with saturation hold (anti-windup), optional PT1 low-pass on the D term, integral separation, direction-preserving clamping to max_speed, and a per-term breakdown for diagnostics. from_config() reads gains, control rate and max speed from drone_config.yaml.

description.zh: 输入目标位置、当前位置、可选扰动估计与当前速度，返回 (3 维速度指令, 含 P/I/D/ff/saturated 的 info 字典)。
description.en: Takes target position, current position, optional disturbance estimate and current velocity; returns the 3-D velocity command plus an info dict with P/I/D/ff terms and the saturation flag.

description.zh: 清零积分、误差历史与饱和标志，并复位 D 项滤波器与积分分离器。
description.en: Clears the integral, error history and saturation flag, and resets the D-term filter and integral separator.

description.zh: 类方法：从 ConfigLoader 加载 drone_config，构造按 YAML 增益配置的控制器（配置不可用时回落默认值）。
description.en: Classmethod: loads drone_config through ConfigLoader and builds a controller from the YAML gains, falling back to defaults when the config is unavailable.

name.zh: 数字滤波器与积分分离

description.zh: 对标 Betaflight 的信号处理原语：PT1 一阶低通 y[n]=y[n-1]+α(x[n]-y[n-1])，α 由截止频率与采样周期推出，用于抑制 D 项高频噪声；积分分离器在误差超阈值时冻结积分，防积分饱和；另提供对 3 维误差向量的积分分离批处理函数。
description.en: Betaflight-aligned signal primitives: a PT1 first-order low-pass y[n]=y[n-1]+alpha*(x[n]-y[n-1]) whose alpha derives from cutoff and sample period, used to suppress D-term noise; an integral separator that freezes the I term once the error exceeds a threshold to prevent windup; plus a batch helper applying integral separation to a 3-D error vector.

description.zh: 输入新采样值，返回指数平滑后的输出。
description.en: Feeds a new sample and returns the exponentially smoothed output.

description.zh: 动态修改截止频率并按 rc=1/(2πfc) 重算滤波系数 α。
description.en: Changes the cutoff frequency at runtime and recomputes alpha from rc=1/(2*pi*fc).

description.zh: 把滤波器内部状态置为给定值（默认 0）。
description.en: Sets the internal filter state to the given value (0 by default).

description.zh: 按误差模长判断是否允许积分，并记录冻结标志。
description.en: Decides from the error magnitude whether integration is allowed and latches the frozen flag.

description.zh: 对 3 维误差/积分向量做积分分离，超阈值分量置零后返回。
description.en: Applies integral separation to 3-D error/integral vectors and zeroes the over-threshold components.

description.zh: 随机采样 RRT* 规划器：10% 目标偏置采样、cKDTree 最近邻与半径查询、步长 steering 扩展、球体/圆柱碰撞检测、代价重连（rewire）保证渐进最优、回溯路径并做避障中值平滑；支持超时与最大迭代上限，未精确到达时返回最近节点路径。圆柱碰撞模型对应风机塔筒场景。
description.en: Sampling-based RRT* planner: 10% goal-biased sampling, cKDTree nearest-neighbour and radius queries, step-size steering, sphere/cylinder collision checks, cost-based rewiring for asymptotic optimality, path backtracking and collision-safe midpoint smoothing. Bounded by max iterations and a timeout; when the goal is not reached exactly it returns the nearest-node path. The cylinder model targets the turbine-tower scenario.

description.zh: 从目标回溯父节点还原路径，并做拉直式平滑与路径级碰撞复检。
description.en: Backtracks parent pointers from the goal to recover the path, then straightens it and re-checks the whole path for collisions.

description.zh: 整条路径碰撞复检。
description.en: Whole-path collision re-check.

description.zh: 回溯父节点还原路径。
description.en: Backtracks to recover the path.

description.zh: 路径平滑。
description.en: Smooths the path.

description.zh: RRT* 本体与对外 plan() 入口：迭代上限、步长、重连开关与障碍物列表的装配。
description.en: The RRT* planner itself and its public plan() entry: iteration budget, step size, rewire switch and obstacle list assembly.

description.zh: 规划起点到目标的可行路径。
description.en: Plans a feasible path from start to goal.

description.zh: 随机采样、最近邻搜索、朝目标扩展，以及球形/圆柱体障碍物与整条路径的碰撞判定。
description.en: Random sampling, nearest-neighbour search, steering toward the goal, plus sphere/cylinder obstacle and whole-path collision checks.

description.zh: 随机采样节点。
description.en: Samples a random node.

description.zh: 最近邻搜索。
description.en: Nearest-neighbour search.

description.zh: 朝采样点扩展。
description.en: Steers toward the sample.

description.zh: 风机圆柱体碰撞判定。
description.en: Turbine-cylinder collision test.

description.zh: 邻域重连（渐近最优性）。
description.en: Neighbourhood rewiring for asymptotic optimality.

description.zh: Tello 无人机接口层：状态机驱动的连接与飞行控制、Mock 替身、20Hz RC 速度指令管理、可复现的单指令 schema 与四后端执行器、SDK 状态解析、解耦的视频流采集。真机经 djitellopy，无硬件时全程 mock。
description.en: Tello drone interface layer: state-machine-driven connection and flight control, a Mock stand-in, a 20 Hz RC velocity-command manager, a reproducible single-command schema with a four-backend runner, SDK state parsing, and decoupled video capture. Real hardware via djitellopy, fully mocked without it.

description.zh: 面向任意 DroneInterface 的指令调度：execute_instant 用反射调用 connect/takeoff/land/emergency/kill/hover/move_to 并回读后端状态（不做动力学 settle，因为真机指令异步）；run_altitude_hold 在 AltitudeHoldDriver 上设定目标高度并步进 settle_s 秒，取稳态均值算误差，并在指令被拒（如 bridge 409 busy）时直接返回 accepted=False，不产出误导性的 settled=True 证据。
description.en: Command dispatch over any DroneInterface: execute_instant reflectively calls connect/takeoff/land/emergency/kill/hover/move_to and reads back the backend state (no settling, since real commands are asynchronous); run_altitude_hold sets an absolute altitude on an AltitudeHoldDriver, steps settle_s seconds and derives the error from the steady-state mean, returning accepted=False outright when the command is rejected (e.g. bridge 409 busy) instead of emitting misleading settled=True evidence.

description.zh: 执行一次性指令并返回 CommandResult；不支持的 op 抛 ValueError，缺少方法抛 AttributeError。
description.en: Executes a one-shot command and returns a CommandResult; unknown ops raise ValueError and missing methods raise AttributeError.

description.zh: 通用高度保持运行器：设定目标高度、按 dt 步进 settle_s 秒、输出统一稳态误差结果，并按 seed 固定随机性以便复现。
description.en: Generic altitude-hold runner: sets the target, steps settle_s seconds at dt, and reports the unified steady-state result, seeding the RNG for reproducibility.

description.zh: 把一条飞行指令表达为可复现的 FlightCommand（op/params/note，支持字典互转；move_to 单位 cm、altitude_hold 单位 m）与统一可序列化结果 CommandResult（accepted/target_m/measured_m/error_m/steady_std_m/settled，证据等级 evidence_level 默认 simulation-only，避免仿真数据冒充实测），并定义动态指令驱动协议 AltitudeHoldDriver 供 mock/内置仿真/OmniSim/真机四后端共同实现。
description.en: Represents one flight command as a reproducible FlightCommand (op/params/note with dict round-trip; move_to in cm, altitude_hold in m) and a serializable CommandResult (accepted/target_m/measured_m/error_m/steady_std_m/settled with evidence_level defaulting to simulation-only so simulated numbers cannot masquerade as measurements), plus the AltitudeHoldDriver protocol shared by the mock, built-in simulation, OmniSim and real-drone backends.

description.zh: 把指令序列化为 {op, params, note} 字典。
description.en: Serializes the command to an {op, params, note} dict.

description.zh: 从字典重建指令（params/note 缺省为空）。
description.en: Rebuilds a command from a dict, defaulting params/note to empty.

description.zh: 输出可直接 json.dumps 的结果字典，并附加 source=SeaBreeze-Inspector 标记。
description.en: Emits a json.dumps-ready result dict tagged with source=SeaBreeze-Inspector.

description.zh: 协议方法：设定绝对目标高度（米），返回是否被后端接受。
description.en: Protocol method: sets the absolute target altitude in metres and reports whether the backend accepted it.

description.zh: 协议方法：按给定动力学步长运行 seconds 秒，返回含 altitude_m/std_m/n_steps 的稳态统计。
description.en: Protocol method: steps the dynamics for the given seconds and returns steady-state stats with altitude_m/std_m/n_steps.

description.zh: 离线测试用 Tello 替身：在内存中维护飞行标志、电量、高度、位置与姿态，实现连接/起降/紧急与各路位移指令，并提供电量、高度、姿态、位置与标准化状态字典读接口，使 runtime 与任务层无需真机即可跑通全流程。
description.en: Tello stand-in for offline testing: keeps flight flag, battery, height, position and attitude in memory, implements connect/takeoff/land/emergency and the per-axis move commands, and exposes battery, height, attitude, position and a normalized state-dict readout so runtime and mission code can run end to end without hardware.

description.zh: 模拟连接，恒返回 True。
description.en: Simulated connection, always returns True.

description.zh: 模拟起飞：置飞行标志并把高度设为 50cm。
description.en: Simulated takeoff: sets the flying flag and height to 50 cm.

description.zh: 模拟降落：清除飞行标志并把高度归零。
description.en: Simulated landing: clears the flying flag and zeroes the height.

description.zh: 模拟前进，按距离累加位置（另有 back/left/right/up/down 同类接口）。
description.en: Simulated forward move accumulating position by distance (back/left/right/up/down share this shape).

description.zh: 返回 battery/height/position/attitude/is_flying 的标准状态字典。
description.en: Returns the standard state dict with battery/height/position/attitude/is_flying.

description.zh: 以独立守护线程 20Hz 持续下发 rc_control 的生命周期管理器：set_command 对 lr/fb/ud/yaw 做 ±100 cm/s 限幅；0.5s 无新指令自动归零（防飞丢）；每 3s 发一次 keepalive 维持连接；stop() 先停线程再补发一次归零指令。mock 模式下只更新状态、不触碰硬件。
description.en: Lifecycle manager that streams rc_control from a daemon thread at 20 Hz: set_command clamps lr/fb/ud/yaw to +/-100 cm/s, the command auto-zeroes after 0.5 s without an update (anti-flyaway), a keepalive is sent every 3 s, and stop() joins the thread then sends one final zero. In mock mode it only tracks state, never touching hardware.

description.zh: 启动 20Hz RC 发送守护线程（重复调用无副作用）。
description.en: Starts the 20 Hz RC sender daemon thread (idempotent).

description.zh: 停止发送线程（最多等 1s）并补发一次全零指令。
description.en: Stops the sender thread (joining up to 1 s) and sends one final all-zero command.

description.zh: 设置 lr/fb/ud/yaw 速度指令，各轴限幅到 ±100 并刷新超时计时。
description.en: Sets the lr/fb/ud/yaw velocity command, clamping each axis to +/-100 and refreshing the timeout clock.

description.zh: 把 djitellopy 的原始状态字典（pitch/roll/yaw/vgx/vgy/vgz/tof/h/bat/baro）规范化为 EKF 可用的量：vg* 由 dm/s ×10 转 cm/s，输出 height(cm)/battery/temperature 与速度向量；velocity_approx 明确标注为速度差分近似而非真实加速度（N12 说明），避免下游误当加速度使用。
description.en: Normalizes the raw djitellopy state dict (pitch/roll/yaw/vgx/vgy/vgz/tof/h/bat/baro) into EKF-ready quantities: vg* converted from dm/s to cm/s by a factor of 10, plus height (cm), battery, temperature and a velocity vector. velocity_approx is explicitly flagged as a velocity-difference approximation rather than true acceleration (note N12) so downstream code cannot mistake it for one.

description.zh: 解析原始状态字典，输出速度/高度/电量/温度的标准化字典；空输入返回空字典。
description.en: Parses the raw state dict into normalized velocity/height/battery/temperature fields; an empty input yields an empty dict.

description.zh: 从 Tello 对象读取 get_current_state 并解析，读取异常时告警并返回空字典。
description.en: Reads get_current_state from a Tello object and parses it, warning and returning an empty dict on failure.

description.zh: 以 FlightState 枚举（IDLE/CONNECTING/CONNECTED/TAKING_OFF/HOVERING/MOVING/LANDING/EMERGENCY/DISCONNECTED）与 TRANSITIONS 表驱动的 Tello 控制器。connect 经 djitellopy 连接；emergency 改为高空受控高速下降、仅当高度 ≤300cm 才硬停桨（P0-1 修复，kill 单独暴露硬停桨）；move_to 用位移指令执行相对移动；mock=True 时全程不触碰硬件。
description.en: Tello controller driven by the FlightState enum (IDLE/CONNECTING/CONNECTED/TAKING_OFF/HOVERING/MOVING/LANDING/EMERGENCY/DISCONNECTED) and a TRANSITIONS table. connect goes through djitellopy; emergency now performs a controlled high-speed descent and only cuts the motors below 300 cm (P0-1 fix, with kill exposed separately); move_to issues relative displacement commands; mock=True keeps the whole flow off hardware.

description.zh: 连接 Tello（mock 时直接成功），失败打印错误并回到 IDLE。
description.en: Connects to the Tello (immediate success when mocking); on failure it logs the error and returns to IDLE.

description.zh: 仅在 CONNECTED 状态允许起飞，成功转入 HOVERING，失败转入 EMERGENCY。
description.en: Allows takeoff only from CONNECTED, moving to HOVERING on success and EMERGENCY on failure.

description.zh: 从 HOVERING/MOVING 降落，失败时触发紧急状态。
description.en: Lands from HOVERING/MOVING and triggers the emergency path if landing fails.

description.zh: 受控紧急降落：高空只做最大速度下降，高度 ≤300cm 才调用 SDK emergency 停桨。
description.en: Controlled emergency descent: at altitude it only descends at maximum speed and calls the SDK emergency stop below 300 cm.

description.zh: 按相对位移 (x,y,z) cm 移动，各轴超过 20cm 才下发指令，非飞行状态直接拒绝。
description.en: Moves by relative (x,y,z) in cm, issuing a command per axis only above 20 cm, and refuses outright when not flying.

description.zh: 生产者-消费者解耦的视频采集：守护线程持续抓帧写入 maxsize=2 的队列（满则丢弃最旧帧以保低延迟），同时在线程锁下更新最新帧缓存；get_frame 非阻塞取帧并清空陈旧帧，队列为空时回落到缓存；附带 1s 窗口的 FPS 统计。mock 模式生成 640×480 随机帧供 UI 联调。
description.en: Producer-consumer video capture: a daemon thread keeps grabbing frames into a maxsize=2 queue (dropping the oldest frame when full to keep latency low) while updating a lock-protected latest-frame cache. get_frame takes a frame without blocking, drains stale frames and falls back to the cache when the queue is empty, with 1 s-window FPS statistics. Mock mode fabricates 640x480 random frames for UI work.

description.zh: 启动抓帧守护线程并返回 True。
description.en: Starts the frame-grabber daemon thread and returns True.

description.zh: 非阻塞取最新帧（清空陈旧帧），队列空时返回缓存帧或 None。
description.en: Non-blocking retrieval of the freshest frame (draining stale ones), returning the cached frame or None when empty.

description.zh: 停止采集并等待线程退出（最多 1s）。
description.en: Stops capture and joins the thread with a 1 s timeout.

description.zh: 只读属性：最近 1s 窗口的实测帧率。
description.en: Read-only property: measured frame rate over the last 1 s window.

description.zh: 硬件抽象层的抽象基类契约：DroneInterface（连接/起飞/降落/受控紧急下降/kill 近地硬停桨/相对移动/悬停/电量/高度/姿态/状态字典/是否在飞）、ArmInterface（关节角与末端位姿）、VisionInterface（检测）。仿真与真机实现同一组接口，任务层只依赖抽象。
description.en: The HAL abstract contracts: DroneInterface (connect/takeoff/land/controlled emergency/kill hard-cut near ground/relative move/hover/battery/height/attitude/state dict/is-flying), ArmInterface (joint angles and end-effector pose) and VisionInterface (detect). Simulation and real hardware implement the same interfaces; the mission layer depends only on abstractions.

description.zh: 建立与无人机的连接，返回是否成功。
description.en: Establishes the drone connection and returns success.

description.zh: 受控紧急下降（非立即停桨）：高空快速但可控下降，近地才允许升级硬停。
description.en: Controlled emergency descent, not an immediate motor stop: a fast but controlled descent at altitude, escalating only near the ground.

description.zh: 立即停桨（硬杀），仅限近地 (<3m) 使用，禁止高空调用。
description.en: Immediate motor stop (hard kill), allowed only near the ground (<3 m) and never at altitude.

description.zh: 设置 [base, shoulder, elbow] 关节角（度）。
description.en: Sets the [base, shoulder, elbow] joint angles in degrees.

description.zh: 对一帧图像执行缺陷检测，返回 class_name/confidence/bbox 列表。
description.en: Runs defect detection on a frame, returning class_name/confidence/bbox records.

description.zh: 接在 EKF 之前的可信位置来源：统一观测契约（位置 cm/z-up + 单调时钟时间戳 + 0..1 质量分 + 有效期/质量阈值），以及真实 ArUco 解算与注入式真值两种实现。没有可用观测时一律返回 None —— 绝不返回占位坐标。真机上它是导航/巡检/返航闸门的唯一依据。
description.en: Trusted position sources feeding the EKF: one observation contract (cm/z-up position, monotonic timestamp, 0..1 quality, max-age/quality thresholds) plus real ArUco solving and an injected ground-truth implementation. No usable observation means None — never a placeholder position. On hardware it is the only basis for navigate/inspect/return gates.

description.zh: 真实 ArUco 定位：检测标记 → solvePnP 解位姿 → 世界坐标（cm，z-up），质量分 = exp(-重投影误差/3.0) × min(1, 标记数/2)，依据是实测残差而非估计。被动推帧式：由主循环每帧把视频帧推进来（read_frame），未检出/解算失败/内参未标定一律返回 None。实测单标记误差 1.867cm、双标记 1.478cm。
description.en: Real ArUco localization: detect markers, solvePnP, then world coordinates (cm, z-up) with quality = exp(-reprojection error/3.0) x min(1, markers/2), grounded in measured residuals. Passively frame-driven: the main loop pushes each frame via read_frame; no detection, failed solve or uncalibrated intrinsics all yield None. Measured error: 1.867 cm single marker, 1.478 cm two markers.

description.zh: 推入一帧并解算；成功则缓存一条带时间戳/质量的观测。
description.en: Pushes one frame and solves it, caching a timestamped, quality-scored observation.

description.zh: 取最近一次观测并做可用性判定（过期/低质量即 None）。
description.en: Returns the latest observation after usability checks (None when stale or low quality).

description.zh: 设置相机内参与畸变；未标定时定位不可用。
description.en: Sets camera intrinsics and distortion; without calibration localization stays unusable.

name.zh: 观测契约与可用性判定

description.zh: 外部定位的统一契约与判定：LocalizationObservation（位置/时间戳/质量/来源，只规范化不抛异常）与 LocalizationSource 抽象基类；is_finite/is_usable/age 三个判定把维度错误、nan/inf、质量不足与过期统一收口为"不可用"，让"坏观测"与"没有观测"在类型上可区分。阈值 MAX_AGE_S=0.3、MIN_QUALITY=0.3 依据实测残差给出。
description.en: The localization contract: LocalizationObservation (position/timestamp/quality/source, normalising rather than raising) and the LocalizationSource ABC; is_finite/is_usable/age collapse bad dimensions, nan/inf, low quality and staleness into "unusable", keeping "bad observation" distinct from "no observation". Thresholds MAX_AGE_S=0.3 and MIN_QUALITY=0.3 come from measured residuals.

description.zh: 维度/有限性 + 质量分 + 有效期三者全过才算可用。
description.en: Usable only when dimensions/finiteness, quality and age all pass.

description.zh: 观测年龄（秒），未来时间戳会给出负值从而被判不可用。
description.en: Observation age in seconds; future timestamps go negative and are rejected.

description.zh: 读一次观测；无可用观测返回 None（禁止占位坐标）。
description.en: Reads one observation, returning None when unusable (no placeholder positions).

description.zh: 给仿真/HIL 用的真值定位源：由外部（仿真器或测试）注入位置，自己只负责包装成符合契约的观测（带时间戳与质量）。它把"定位可用"这件事从具体算法解耦，使状态闸门与 EKF 接线能在没有相机的情况下被确定性地测试。
description.en: A ground-truth source for simulation/HIL: position is injected externally (simulator or test) and merely wrapped into a contract-conforming observation with timestamp and quality. It decouples "localization available" from any specific algorithm, making the gates and EKF wiring testable without a camera.

description.zh: 返回最新注入位置包装成的观测（无注入则 None）。
description.en: Returns the latest injected position as an observation (None when nothing injected).

description.zh: 后端主调度：MissionController 的构造与配置装配、8 状态任务机与状态变更接口、单帧控制循环与安全检查/日志/消息总线，以及 argparse 命令行入口。仿真与真机路径共用同一个控制器。
description.en: The backend dispatcher: MissionController construction and config wiring, the eight-state mission machine with its transition API, the per-frame control loop with safety checks, logging and the message bus, and the argparse CLI entry. Simulation and real-hardware paths share the same controller.

description.zh: python backend/main.py 的命令行入口：解析 --mode(simulation|hardware)/--target x,y,z(cm)/--mock，构造 MissionController 并设目标，捕获 Ctrl+C 与异常后走紧急降落，最后在 finally 中调用 stop() 保证优雅关闭。另导出 MainController 兼容别名。
description.en: CLI entry for python backend/main.py: parses --mode (simulation or hardware), --target x,y,z in cm and --mock, builds MissionController and sets the target, turns Ctrl+C and exceptions into an emergency descent, and always calls stop() in finally for a graceful shutdown. Also exports the MainController compatibility alias.

description.zh: 命令行入口：解析参数、构造控制器、设目标并启动，异常路径触发紧急降落。
description.en: CLI entry: parses arguments, builds the controller, sets the target and starts, triggering an emergency descent on the exception path.

description.zh: MissionController 的兼容别名（角色文档使用的旧名）。
description.en: Compatibility alias for MissionController used by older role documents.

label.zh: 按命令行参数构造控制器

description.zh: MissionController 的装配与公共访问器：按模式加载配置（硬件模式配置失败即 fail-fast）、按 config 构建前馈 PID 与三级安全阈值、组合 EKF/规划器/检测器/Tello/RC/视频/日志/消息总线，并暴露电量、检测数、紧急原因、状态字典与安全重置。
description.en: MissionController assembly and public accessors: loads config per mode (hardware fails fast on config errors), builds the feedforward PID and three-tier safety thresholds from config, composes EKF, planner, detector, Tello, RC, video, logger and message bus, and exposes battery, detection count, emergency reason, state dict and safe reset.

label.zh: 加载 drone_config（硬件模式失败即抛）
组合飞行日志记录器
构建三级安全监控并按 config 覆盖阈值
订阅命令与状态 topic

name.zh: 控制器装配与配置回退

description.zh: MissionController 构造：配置读取与安全回退、EKF/控制器/安全监控/日志/总线等子模块的构建与订阅。
description.en: MissionController construction: config read with safe fallback, plus construction and subscription of the EKF, controller, safety monitor, logger and bus.

description.zh: 装配控制器。
description.en: Assembles the controller.

description.zh: 构建控制器。
description.en: Builds the controller.

description.zh: 构建安全监控。
description.en: Builds the safety guard.

description.zh: 对外查询面：完整状态字典（含 EKF 马氏距离）、电量读写、检测计数与紧急原因，以及任务复位。
description.en: The outward query surface: the full state dict (including EKF Mahalanobis distance), battery access, detection count and emergency reason, plus mission reset.

description.zh: 返回完整状态字典。
description.en: Returns the full state dict.

description.zh: 读电量。
description.en: Reads the battery.

description.zh: 设置电量（0-100 限幅）。
description.en: Sets the battery with 0-100 clamping.

description.zh: 安全复位任务。
description.en: Resets the mission safely.

description.zh: 读紧急原因。
description.en: Reads the emergency reason.

description.zh: MissionController 的 8 状态处理与状态变更接口：IDLE/TAKEOFF/HOVERING/NAVIGATE/INSPECT/RETURN/LAND/EMERGENCY 各自的期望行为（含受控紧急下降与近地升级硬停桨），以及 set_target/takeoff/plan_path/request_state（走转换表校验）/trigger_emergency。
description.en: MissionController's eight state handlers and state-change API: the expected behaviour of IDLE/TAKEOFF/HOVERING/NAVIGATE/INSPECT/RETURN/LAND/EMERGENCY, including controlled emergency descent and near-ground escalation to a hard cut, plus set_target/takeoff/plan_path/request_state (validated by the transition table)/trigger_emergency.

label.zh: 状态转换表校验

description.zh: 对外任务命令：起飞、状态请求（经转换表校验）、目标设定、路径规划与紧急触发。
description.en: Outward mission commands: takeoff, state request (validated by the transition table), target setting, path planning and emergency trigger.

description.zh: 从 IDLE 起飞。
description.en: Takes off from IDLE.

description.zh: 请求状态转换。
description.en: Requests a state transition.

description.zh: 设定目标位置。
description.en: Sets the target position.

description.zh: 规划巡检路径。
description.en: Plans the inspection path.

description.zh: 触发紧急。
description.en: Triggers emergency.

description.zh: 八状态任务机的逐帧推进：按当前状态分发行为（起飞/悬停/巡检/导航/返航），并把扰动与检测结果融入转移条件。
description.en: Per-frame advance of the 8-state mission FSM: behaviour dispatch by current state (takeoff, hover, inspect, navigate, return) with disturbance and detections folded into the transition conditions.

description.zh: 推进状态机。
description.en: Advances the state machine.

description.zh: 主调度循环与安全/遥测接线：start() 固定周期主循环、_update() 单帧（总线命令→传感器/EKF→安全→状态机→日志→发布状态）、仿真注入入口 update_with_external_data、分层 Failsafe 判定、视频帧注入与优雅关闭（轮询触地、超时兜底硬停桨）。
description.en: The dispatcher loop and safety/telemetry wiring: the fixed-period start() loop, the single-frame _update() (bus commands, sensors and EKF, safety, state machine, log, publish state), the simulation injection entry update_with_external_data, tiered failsafe judgement, video-frame injection and graceful shutdown with touchdown polling and hard-cut fallback.

label.zh: 每帧分层安全检查（WARN/LAND/KILL）
发布任务状态到总线
每帧记录位置/扰动/检测框

name.zh: 传感器注入与控制输出

description.zh: 仿真注入入口与每帧管线：总线命令、传感器取值、安全检查，并回传控制输出与状态。
description.en: The simulation injection entry and the per-frame pipeline: bus commands, sensor read, safety check, returning control output and state.

description.zh: 外部数据注入入口。
description.en: External-data injection entry.

description.zh: 处理总线命令。
description.en: Processes bus commands.

description.zh: 取传感器值。
description.en: Reads sensors.

description.zh: 分层安全检查。
description.en: Tiered safety check.

description.zh: 优雅关闭（降落并轮询触地、超时硬停桨、停线程、存日志、停总线）、逐帧日志记录与外部视频帧注入。
description.en: Graceful shutdown (land and poll for touchdown, hard cut on timeout, stop threads, save logs, stop the bus), per-frame logging and external video-frame injection.

description.zh: 优雅关闭。
description.en: Graceful shutdown.

description.zh: 记录一帧。
description.en: Logs one frame.

description.zh: 注入视频帧。
description.en: Injects a video frame.

name.zh: 主循环启动与单帧推进

description.zh: 固定周期主循环的启动（起日志/视频、真机失败降级为 mock）与单帧控制逻辑 _update()。
description.en: Starting the fixed-period main loop (begins logging/video, falls back to mock if the real link fails) and the single-frame control logic in _update().

description.zh: 启动主循环。
description.en: Starts the main loop.

description.zh: 单帧控制循环。
description.en: Single control frame.

description.zh: 任务语义与安全约束的单源权威：8 个任务状态枚举 + 合法转换表 + 历史别名收口，以及 WARN/LAND/KILL 三级失效保护监视器。仿真、主调度与 HTTP 桥都从这里取状态名与安全级别，不得自造状态字符串。
description.en: Single source of truth for mission semantics and safety limits: the eight mission states with their legal transition table and alias normalisation, plus the three-tier WARN/LAND/KILL failsafe monitor. Simulation, the main dispatcher and the HTTP bridge take state names and safety levels from here only.

description.zh: 三级安全监控：按电池、姿态角、高度与心跳超时判定 OK/WARN/LAND/KILL（优先级 KILL > LAND > WARN），阈值可被配置覆盖。提供心跳、可恢复判定与手动重置——低电触发后不再永久锁死。
description.en: Three-tier safety monitoring: judges OK/WARN/LAND/KILL from battery, attitude, height and heartbeat timeout (priority KILL > LAND > WARN) with configurable thresholds. Provides heartbeat, recoverability check and manual reset, so a low-battery trip no longer locks the vehicle permanently.

description.zh: 按电池/姿态/高度/心跳返回最高级别的安全事件。
description.en: Returns the highest-severity safety event for battery, attitude, height and heartbeat.

description.zh: 更新心跳时间，调用方每帧调用以避免误报通信中断。
description.en: Refreshes the heartbeat timestamp; callers invoke it every frame to avoid false link-loss alarms.

description.zh: 判断当前级别能否自动恢复（OK/WARN 可，KILL 需手动 reset）。
description.en: Reports whether the current level can auto-recover; KILL needs a manual reset.

description.zh: 重置监控状态（KILL 后恢复）。
description.en: Resets monitor state, recovering from a KILL trip.

description.zh: 安全级别枚举 OK/WARN/LAND/KILL。
description.en: The OK/WARN/LAND/KILL safety-level enum.

description.zh: 全系统唯一的任务状态定义：IDLE/TAKEOFF/HOVERING/NAVIGATE/INSPECT/RETURN/LAND/EMERGENCY 枚举、合法转换表，以及把 TAKING_OFF/RETURNING/LANDING/HOVER 等历史别名规范化、拒绝未知状态名的收口函数。非法转换会显式抛错而不静默。
description.en: The system's only mission-state definition: the IDLE/TAKEOFF/HOVERING/NAVIGATE/INSPECT/RETURN/LAND/EMERGENCY enum, the legal transition table, and normalisers that fold historical aliases (TAKING_OFF/RETURNING/LANDING/HOVER) while rejecting unknown names. Illegal transitions raise instead of passing silently.

description.zh: 把任意历史状态名规范化为权威名，非法名抛 ValueError。
description.en: Normalises any historical state name to the authoritative name, raising ValueError for unknown ones.

description.zh: 字符串或枚举 → MissionState 枚举（别名自动规范化）。
description.en: Converts a string or enum to a MissionState enum, folding aliases.

description.zh: 判断状态转换是否在合法转换表中。
description.en: Checks whether a transition is legal in the transition table.

description.zh: 执行状态转换，非法时抛异常并带理由。
description.en: Performs a transition, raising with the reason when illegal.

description.zh: 是否为合法任务状态（含历史别名）。
description.en: Reports whether a name is a valid mission state, aliases included.

description.zh: 接入外部 OmniSim 的 Mavic bridge（HTTP）与统一口径高度保持 CLI：真实遥测轮询、显式机型标注（mavic-2-pro，避免把 Mavic 数据误读成 Tello）、未配置 OMNISIM_BASE_URL 或 bridge fault 一律显式报错，绝不拿目标值冒充测量。
description.en: Integration with the external OmniSim Mavic bridge over HTTP plus the unified altitude-hold CLI: real telemetry polling, explicit model labelling (mavic-2-pro, so Mavic data is never read as Tello), and hard errors when OMNISIM_BASE_URL is missing or the bridge reports a fault, never substituting the target for a measurement.

description.zh: OmniSim Mavic bridge 的 HTTP 驱动：POST /action 下发 takeoff（wait=true）并区分 409 忙碌与 fault，GET /state 轮询 z 与 mode；settle 按最后 5 秒均值统计稳态高度，并显式声明 n_steps 是轮询次数而非物理步数；z 缺失时跳过而不静默当 0 参与均值。
description.en: HTTP driver for the OmniSim Mavic bridge: POST /action issues takeoff with wait=true and distinguishes 409 busy from a fault, GET /state polls z and mode; settle averages the last five seconds and states that n_steps counts polls, not physics steps; missing z is skipped rather than silently averaged as zero.

description.zh: 把"理想链路"补成现实链路：传感器离散延迟线（样本带采样时刻，可查测量年龄）/ 可复现丢包（i.i.d. 伯努利或 Gilbert-Elliott 突发，两状态马尔可夫）/ 上行指令链路（延迟+丢包+冷启动语义）/ 执行器一阶惯性（PT1 解析解，非欧拉）。默认全 0 时严格直通、逐位不变。丢包序列同 seed 可复现，且只在"真有包到期"时掷骰。
description.en: Turns an ideal link into a realistic one: a discrete sensor delay line carrying sample timestamps (so measurement age is queryable), reproducible loss (i.i.d. Bernoulli or Gilbert-Elliott burst), an uplink command path (delay + loss + cold-start semantics) and first-order actuator lag (analytic PT1, not Euler). All defaults are strict pass-through, bit-identical. Loss sequences are seed-reproducible and only consume randomness when a packet is actually due.

description.zh: 全系统唯一的进程内消息总线。每个 topic 维护独立订阅队列（满时丢弃最旧），publish 一次性扇出到全部订阅者并返回投递数；订阅者用 read_latest 非阻塞取最新一帧，无 dispatch 线程。同时登记 drone/arm/ekf/vision/safety/mission/log 全部 topic 常量。
description.en: The only in-process message bus in the system. Each topic keeps its own subscriber queue (oldest dropped when full); publish fans out once to every subscriber and returns the delivered count; subscribers poll non-blockingly with read_latest and there is no dispatch thread. Also holds every drone/arm/ekf/vision/safety/mission/log topic constant.

description.zh: 全项目唯一的单位与坐标系转换点：cm↔m↔mm、m/s↔cm/s、m/s²↔cm/s²，以及后端 z-up(cm) 与 Web three.js y-up(m) 的边界映射。约定跨模块转换必须走这里，禁止手工乘除 100（发现即 code review 打回）。
description.en: The project's only unit and coordinate-frame conversion point: cm↔m↔mm, m/s↔cm/s, m/s²↔cm/s², plus the boundary mapping between backend z-up (cm) and web three.js y-up (m). Cross-module conversion must go through here; hand-rolled x100 is rejected in review.

description.en: Web position (m, y-up) to backend position (cm, z-up).

description.zh: 风机叶片缺陷检测视觉：YOLO 推理（裂纹/腐蚀/前缘损伤三类，异常自动降级 mock 不中断主循环）、无权重 Mock 检测器、YOLOv8n 训练入口、LabelMe→YOLO 标签转换与训练/验证集划分。
description.en: Wind-turbine blade defect vision: YOLO inference for crack/corrosion/leading-edge damage that degrades to mock instead of breaking the main loop, a weight-free Mock detector, a YOLOv8n training entry point, and LabelMe-to-YOLO label conversion with train/val splitting.

description.zh: 训练数据准备：把 LabelMe JSON 多边形标注转成 YOLO 归一化中心点格式 txt（类别映射 crack/corrosion/leading_edge_damage → 0/1/2），并保留 convert_labelme_to_yolo 兼容别名；split_dataset 按比例划分训练/验证集，同时成对返回图像与标签路径，并跳过缺少同名 .txt 标签的图像。
description.en: Training-data preparation: converts LabelMe JSON polygons into YOLO normalized-centre txt (mapping crack/corrosion/leading_edge_damage to 0/1/2) with a convert_labelme_to_yolo compatibility alias; split_dataset divides images and labels into train/val while returning them in pairs and skipping images that lack a matching .txt label.

description.zh: 把单个 LabelMe JSON 转成同名 YOLO txt 并返回输出路径。
description.en: Converts one LabelMe JSON into a same-named YOLO txt and returns the output path.

description.zh: labelme_to_yolo 的兼容别名，签名一致。
description.en: Compatibility alias of labelme_to_yolo with an identical signature.

description.zh: 按 train_ratio 划分数据集，返回 (训练图, 验证图, 训练标签, 验证标签) 四元组。
description.en: Splits the dataset by train_ratio, returning the (train images, val images, train labels, val labels) tuple.

description.zh: 叶片缺陷检测推理：类别 0=crack / 1=corrosion / 2=leading_edge_damage，并把旧数据集的 erosion/rust 别名归一为 corrosion；参数缺省时从 yolo_config.yaml 读取权重路径、置信度与设备。detect 对空帧直接返回，推理或结果解析抛异常时打印 traceback 并自动降级到 mock 检测，保证主循环不断。输出含 class_id/class_name/confidence/bbox/severity。
description.en: Blade defect inference: classes 0=crack, 1=corrosion, 2=leading_edge_damage with legacy erosion/rust aliases normalized to corrosion; weights path, confidence and device default from yolo_config.yaml. detect returns immediately on empty frames, and on inference or parsing errors prints a traceback and degrades to mock detection so the main loop never dies. Outputs class_id/class_name/confidence/bbox/severity.

description.zh: 对单帧推理并返回检测框列表（含类别名、置信度、像素 bbox 与严重度），异常自动切换 mock 模式。
description.en: Runs inference on one frame and returns detection dicts with class name, confidence, pixel bbox and severity, switching to mock mode on error.

description.zh: 在图像副本上按类别颜色绘制检测框与 "name conf" 标签并返回。
description.en: Draws coloured boxes and name/confidence labels on a copy of the image and returns it.

description.zh: 模拟检测：以 4× 下采样帧的 CRC32 为帧内种子生成 0–3 个框，帧内可复现、帧间有变化。
description.en: Mock detection: seeds a per-frame RNG from the CRC32 of a 4x downsampled frame to emit 0-3 boxes, reproducible within a frame and varying across frames.

description.zh: 按置信度分档估计轻/中/重严重度（已在注释中说明其局限）。
description.en: Buckets confidence into light/moderate/severe severity (its limitations are documented in the source).

description.zh: 无需模型权重的缺陷检测替身，供 UI 开发与测试：用 4× 下采样帧的 CRC32 作种子，保证同一帧结果一致、不同帧结果不同；每次生成 0–4 个带 center 字段的检测框；draw_results 统一按 class_name 绘制（兼容旧的 class 字段）。继承 DefectDetector 以复用严重度估计与配色。
description.en: Weight-free defect-detection stand-in for UI development and tests: seeds its RNG from the CRC32 of a 4x downsampled frame so a given frame yields identical results while different frames vary, emits 0-4 boxes carrying a center field, and draw_results always keys on class_name (with a legacy class fallback). It subclasses DefectDetector to reuse severity estimation and colours.

description.zh: 生成 0–4 个模拟检测框（含 center），空帧返回空列表。
description.en: Generates 0-4 simulated detections (including center), returning an empty list for empty frames.

description.zh: 按 class_name 在图像副本上绘制框与 "name: conf" 标签并返回。
description.en: Draws boxes and name: confidence labels keyed on class_name onto an image copy and returns it.

description.zh: 基于 ultralytics API 的 YOLOv8n 训练入口（python backend/vision/train.py --data data.yaml --epochs 200）：支持 epochs/imgsz/batch/device/resume 参数，训练后可选 model.val() 并打印 mAP50；对缺库、文件缺失、内存不足分别给出可操作提示并返回布尔成功标志，不向上抛异常中断调用方。
description.en: YOLOv8n training entry point over the ultralytics API (python backend/vision/train.py --data data.yaml --epochs 200): accepts epochs/imgsz/batch/device/resume, optionally runs model.val() and prints mAP50, and turns missing libraries, missing files and out-of-memory into actionable messages plus a boolean success flag instead of raising into the caller.

description.zh: 训练 YOLO 模型并按需验证：返回 True/False 表示是否完成，异常分支打印原因与建议。
description.en: Trains the YOLO model and optionally validates it, returning True/False and printing the cause and advice on each failure branch.

description.en: Three single-purpose verifiers behind one entry: models (presence, SHA256, byte count; release candidates must carry full provenance), datasets (content digest and derived version) and environment (declared Python range plus requirements fingerprint). Authority is the content fingerprint; mtime, paths, platform and patch versions are ignored and printed - the root cause of clean-clone failure.

reading.zh: 从「运行主体」看起：backend 是全部算法与控制逻辑，web3d/frontend 是两条可视化通道，firmware 是真机执行端；「硬件与集成」是结构件与外部仿真的接入口；「验证与研发支撑」产出论文里可复现的数字与测试；「资料与数据」是文档和权重/数据集的落点。
reading.en: Start with Runtime System: backend holds all algorithms and control logic, web3d/frontend are the two visualisation channels, firmware is the real-hardware actuator end. Hardware & Integration covers the CAD parts and the external-simulation seam. Verification & R&D Support produces the reproducible numbers and tests. Documentation & Data records where docs and weights/datasets live.

reading.zh: 两类产物：模型权重，以及可提交的数据清单。
reading.en: Two artefact families: model weights and the committable data manifests.

reading.zh: 先看「算法与硬件」（EKF/前馈 PID/机械臂/视觉），再看「平台与仿真」（仿真、单循环 runtime、HAL、OmniSim 桥），最后由「调度与安全」把两者串成任务；utils 是被全部依赖的基础设施。
reading.en: Start with Algorithms & Hardware (EKF, feedforward PID, arm, vision), then Platform & Simulation (simulation, runtime loop, HAL, OmniSim bridge); Dispatch & Safety ties them into a mission. utils is the shared infrastructure everything depends on.

reading.zh: 从左到右：运动学先做正/逆解算出关节角 → 串口控制器把角度变成 Arduino 固件指令下发。
reading.en: Kinematics solves forward/inverse pose first, then the serial controller turns joint angles into firmware commands over the Arduino link.

reading.zh: 从左到右的信号链：滤波器与积分分离提供基础信号处理 → EKF 观测风扰 → 前馈 PID 把扰动补偿进位置控制；RRT* 独立负责路径规划。
reading.en: Left-to-right signal chain: filters and integral separation provide base signal conditioning, the EKF observes wind disturbance, and the feedforward PID folds that compensation into position control; RRT* plans paths independently.

reading.zh: 先看矩阵（F/H）→ 再看使用它们的预测与更新步 → 最后是对外读出接口。
reading.en: Matrices first (F/H), then the predict and update steps that use them, then the read-out queries.

reading.zh: plan() 驱动主循环 → 采样/扩展/碰撞检测生长搜索树 → 回溯与平滑把它变成可飞的路径。
reading.en: plan() drives the loop; sampling, steering and collision checks expand the tree; backtracking and smoothing turn it into a flyable path.

reading.zh: 指令 schema 与状态解析定义契约 → Tello 控制器经指令执行器与 RC 管理器下发 → 视频流提供感知；mock Tello 是无真机时的替身。
reading.en: Command schema and state parsing define the contract, the Tello controller executes through the command runner and RC manager, and the video stream plus mock Tello cover perception and offline testing.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先看观测契约与可用性判定（base），再看两种实现——真实 ArUco 推帧解算，与给仿真/HIL 用的注入式真值。共用的判据是"不可用就返回 None"。
reading.en: Left to right: the observation contract and usability rules first, then the two implementations - real ArUco frame solving and an injected ground-truth source for simulation/HIL. Shared rule: unusable means None.

reading.zh: 同一个 MissionController 的四块：先构造装配（含配置与阈值）→ 8 状态机与状态变更接口 → 单帧循环（总线命令/EKF/安全/日志）→ CLI 入口按参数构造并保证优雅关闭。
reading.en: Four slices of one MissionController: construction and wiring (config, thresholds) to the eight-state machine and its transition API to the per-frame loop (bus commands, EKF, safety, logging) to the CLI entry that builds it and guarantees a graceful shutdown.

reading.zh: 装配层负责把子模块接起来；遥测接口是外部世界读取与复位它的入口。
reading.en: Assembly wires the controller's submodules; the telemetry API is what the outside world reads and resets.

reading.zh: 命令发起状态转换；状态机每帧执行转换后的行为。
reading.en: Commands request transitions; the state machine executes the resulting behaviour every frame.

reading.zh: 先启动主循环并逐帧推进 → 注入传感器并产出控制输出 → 最后优雅关闭并落日志。
reading.en: Start the loop and step one frame; inject sensors and produce control output; shut down gracefully while logging.

reading.zh: 先看 states：状态名与合法转换是任务语义的单源定义；再看 safety：三级失效保护的阈值与事件级别（KILL > LAND > WARN）由主调度每帧消费。
reading.en: Start with states: state names and legal transitions are the single definition of mission semantics. Then safety: its three tiers (KILL > LAND > WARN) are consumed every frame by the dispatcher.

reading.zh: 先看 adapter：它把 Mavic bridge 的 HTTP 接口落成统一的 AltitudeHoldDriver；CLI 只负责按 --backend 选驱动并落盘结果 JSON。
reading.en: Start with adapter: it turns the Mavic bridge HTTP API into the unified AltitudeHoldDriver; the CLI only picks a driver via --backend and writes the result JSON.

reading.zh: 运行时核心拥有控制周期；headless 模式下的输入与状态汇总向它供数。
reading.en: The runtime core owns the control cycle; input and state aggregation feed it in headless mode.

reading.zh: 模型、Pygame 主循环与渲染器构成被仿真的世界；HTTP 桥、无人机适配器与高度驱动器是让 Web 视图和控制器驱动它的接缝。
reading.en: Models, the Pygame loop and the renderer make up the simulated world; the HTTP bridge, drone adapter and altitude driver are the seams that let the web view and the controller drive it.

reading.zh: 处理器暴露 /api/state、/api/command、/api/log → 主循环推进仿真并广播 → 记录器写飞行 CSV。
reading.en: The handler exposes /api/state, /api/command and /api/log; the loop advances the simulation and broadcasts; the recorder writes the flight CSV.

reading.zh: 四旋翼把控制与风扰积分起来；风机与机械臂提供任务几何；虚拟传感器产生 EKF 消费的带噪观测。
reading.en: The quadrotor integrates control plus wind; the turbine and arm provide the task geometry; the virtual sensor produces the noisy measurements the EKF consumes.

reading.zh: 引擎拥有状态与时钟 → 输入把按键变成任务动作 → 帧桥把状态交给渲染器。
reading.en: The engine owns state and timing, input turns keys into mission actions, and the frame bridge hands state to the renderer.

reading.zh: 先投影 → 再画场景（地面/风机/无人机/机械臂/路径/风粒子）→ 最后叠 HUD 与遥测面板。
reading.en: Projection first, then the scene itself (ground, turbine, drone, arm, path, wind), then the HUD and telemetry overlays.

reading.zh: 左组是无状态工具（配置加载、单位换算），右组是运行时设施（消息总线、飞行日志）；飞行日志复用配置里的 PROJECT_ROOT 定位输出目录。
reading.en: Left group holds stateless tools (config loading, unit conversion); right group holds runtime facilities (message bus, flight logging); the logger reuses PROJECT_ROOT from config to locate its output directory.

reading.zh: 加载器负责定位/解析/缓存 → 强转与校验塑造取值 → 配置视图是调用方接触的接口。
reading.en: Loading locates, parses and caches; coercion and validation shape the values; the config view is what callers touch.

reading.zh: 从左到右：数据集工具准备标注与划分 → 训练器拟合模型 → 检测器推理输出缺陷框；mock 检测器用于无权重时的仿真与测试。
reading.en: Left to right: dataset utilities prepare labels and splits, the trainer fits the model, and the defect detector runs inference; the mock detector stands in when no weights are available.

reading.zh: 两类参数：飞行器与机械臂，以及感知模型。
reading.en: Two parameter families: the flight vehicle plus arm, and the perception model.

reading.zh: 先读项目与交接文档建立全局认识，再读接口与推导类技术文档。
reading.en: Start with the project and handover docs for orientation, then the technical guides for interfaces and derivations.

reading.zh: 初始化配置舵机 → 串口协议解析命令 → 平滑运动与看门狗真正安全地驱动关节。
reading.en: Boot initialises the servos, the serial protocol parses commands, and motion plus watchdog actually drive the joints safely.

reading.zh: 总装模型展示怎么装起来，七个结构件是要打印的部分，旧版文件只作历史保留。
reading.en: The assembly shows how it goes together, the seven parts are what you print, and the legacy files are kept only as history.

reading.zh: 在 917 行的桥里自下而上：工具函数 → 风场模型与状态 → Tello 动力学 → 飞行控制器 → HTTP 入口与网格资产。
reading.en: Bottom-up inside the 917-line bridge: helpers, the wind model and state, Tello dynamics, the flight controller, then the HTTP entry and mesh assets.

reading.zh: v5.2 流水线按审计→划分→冻结 OOD 评估→预检顺序阅读；中间组产出增强数据与论文产物；最后一组是外部评审与环境安装。
reading.en: The v5.2 pipeline runs audit, split, frozen-OOD eval and preflight in order; the middle group produces augmented data and paper artefacts; the last group handles external review and env setup.

reading.zh: 自下而上：先算法与硬件单元测试 → 再基础设施与仿真 → 最后跨模块集成。
reading.en: Bottom-up: algorithm and hardware unit tests, then infrastructure and simulation, then cross-module integration.

reading.zh: 先搭环境 → 再烧录固件 → 然后是数据、体检与中继类工具。
reading.en: Set the environment up, flash the board, then the data, diagnostic and relay utilities.

reading.zh: 每个脚本产出一族实测数字：风扰/EKF、悬停精度、机械臂与延迟、检测吞吐。
reading.en: Each script produces one family of measured numbers: wind/EKF, hover accuracy, arm and latency, detection throughput.

reading.zh: 先离线生成资产 → 场景把模型搭起来 → 入口与 HUD 驱动渲染循环 → 数据桥拉取实时遥测。
reading.en: Assets are generated offline, then the scene builds them, the entry plus HUD drive the render loop, and the data bridge pulls live telemetry.
